name: Marketing Agent Risk Review
description: Assess marketing and adtech agents for risky actions, sensitive data exposure, unsafe tool access, and missing human approval boundaries.

operational.approval_boundary: Analysis-only; must not approve campaigns, change spend, publish content, export data, or modify permissions.
operational.use_when: Use when reviewing marketing or adtech agents that touch spend, audiences, product data, analytics, customer data, or publishing workflows.

limitations: Instruction package only; it does not provide or authorize an executable runtime capability.
usability.quickstart: Read SKILL.md and follow the documented workflow.
